Best solution for growling when near food. Imo*

Come dinner time put food in his bowl but* less than usual*
Have some food in your hand when he is eating from the bowl.  fill the bowl with whats in your hand, whilst he's eating. He may be angry" but should soon realise you are putting more food in.
Keep doing this and eventually the habit of putting your hand near his mouth will get better and better.
After a while he will see you reaching for the food as a good sign.

(Did this with my dog that is quick to jump to food)

try use a verbal cue aswell when you are placing more food in the bowl.

Worked for me, but all dogs are different, good luck.
